prompt: Create an original 90 second neoclassical felt piano instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: felt piano, soft cello. Style: spacious broken chords, intimate close room. Tempo approximately 64 BPM; G major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective classical piece featuring a prominent piano melody accompanied by lush orchestral strings. The arrangement builds gently, creating a serene yet emotional atmosphere.
